`enum ResourceAnimationCanvas.Disposal`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.animation` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceAnimationCanvas.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/animation/ResourceAnimationCanvas.java)

What happens to the area of a frame before the next frame is drawn.

## Learn more

- [Custom formats](/use/learn/going-further/custom-formats/)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`NONE`](#ResourceAnimationCanvas-Disposal-value-NONE) | The frame stays, and the next frame is drawn over it. |
| [`BACKGROUND`](#ResourceAnimationCanvas-Disposal-value-BACKGROUND) | The area of the frame is cleared to transparent. |
| [`PREVIOUS`](#ResourceAnimationCanvas-Disposal-value-PREVIOUS) | The canvas goes back to what it was before the frame. |

## Value details

<a id="ResourceAnimationCanvas-Disposal-value-NONE"></a>

### NONE

`NONE` 

The frame stays, and the next frame is drawn over it.

<a id="ResourceAnimationCanvas-Disposal-value-BACKGROUND"></a>

### BACKGROUND

`BACKGROUND` 

The area of the frame is cleared to transparent.

<a id="ResourceAnimationCanvas-Disposal-value-PREVIOUS"></a>

### PREVIOUS

`PREVIOUS`
